summary: Compare values at each point: the Weil representation of the scalar pair (ν, ν), ν = det z⁻¹, is the character value b(det) times translation by z⁻¹.

steps.claim: Two forms are equal when their values agree; compare the values at every point k of V's group (componentwise), and let ν = det(z⁻¹), a norm-one finite adele.
steps.lean:
Subtype.ext
  (by ext k : 2; let ν := U.det (by simp) z⁻¹; simpa [kernelValue, ← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul,
  eq_inv_smul_iff₀, show scalarFin _ ν = z⁻¹ by ext; simp [ν, Gf.atPlace, scalarFin, U.det]] using!
  congr(Y.kernelValue 1 ($(pairWeilFinite_scalarFin Y.auxPair.a Y.auxPair.b ν ν) _).1 (g * z) k))

steps.claim: Unfold the kernel value (kernelValue) at g·z and the operator twistedCentralOp z⁻¹: the left side is b(det(1, z⁻¹))·(kernel value at g translated by the scalar matrix of ν).
The rank-one scalar matrix of ν = det(z⁻¹) is z⁻¹ itself (scalarFin, U.det).
steps.lean: show scalarFin _ ν = z⁻¹ by ext; simp [ν, Gf.atPlace, scalarFin, U.det]

steps.claim: By pairWeilFinite_scalarFin for the scalar pair (ν, ν), the Weil operator of (scalarFin ν, scalarFin ν) is the character value pairChar(a, b)(…) times the operator of (1, scalarFin(ν/ν)) = identity; evaluated at (g·z, k) this gives the equality of the two kernel values.
